headline: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater: skateboarding goes mainstream
title: Tony Hawks Pro Skater Facts | Neversoft 1999 | Classic Games
video_script: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater launched on September twenty ninth, nineteen ninety nine for the PlayStation, made by Neversoft and published by Activision. Its punk rock and ska soundtrack became part of its identity, and each skater has eight grabs, eight grinds and eight flips. It is credited with bringing skateboarding to a more mainstream global audience and led to eight yearly sequels from Neversoft. A remake of the first two games came out in twenty twenty. description: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater (Neversoft/Activision) launched September 29, 1999, spawned eight annual sequels by Neversoft and got a 2020 remake with the second game. Source: Wikipedia.
